name: Turso
tagline: SQLite-compatible edge databases with CLI and platform API.
shortDescription: Turso provides libSQL databases, branching-style workflows, CLI management, platform APIs, and embedded replicas.
agentSummary: Agents can create databases, manage groups/locations/tokens, and use SQLite-compatible workflows from CLI or API.
bestFor: Edge SQLite apps, small product databases, local-first workflows, and embedded replicas.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Production schema/data changes should use backups and human review. Schema changes, migrations, deletes, backups, row-level security, and retention policies need explicit review before agents touch production data. CLI access is powerful but can run destructive local or production commands; prefer dry runs, preview environments, and non-production credentials. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging.
pricingSummary: Public plan pricing with free and usage-based dimensions.
authModel: API tokens, database auth tokens, org/user scoping.
browserSupport: Dashboard supports org, database, token, and usage inspection.

capabilities.detail: Turso CLI manages databases, auth tokens, groups, and shell workflows.
Platform API supports org, database, group, location, and token operations.
Docs include CLI, SDKs, platform API, and local development.
Public plan pricing with free and usage-based dimensions.
Dashboard supports org, database, token, and usage inspection.
The tool has documented test, local, preview, self-hosted, or staging paths that let agents validate changes away from production.
